main_body: thatched roof building with wooden palisade walls and central doorway
top_band: yellow-ochre sloped thatched roof surface from row 5 to row 55 (interrupted at the bottom center by the top of the door frame at rows 48-55)
evidence: The building clearly shows a large sloped top roof surface (rows 5-55) overhanging the vertical south wall (rows 56-78), with a distinct eave overhang casting a 2-row dark shadow at rows 56-57 and a recessed doorway with inner framing.

style.evidence: While the palette uses dark brown material outlines and 5-6 shading steps on the wood and thatch, the roof relies on repetitive horizontal banding rather than rich per-tile or clump detailing, and the open doorway contains a large flat near-black fill (>10x10 px) lacking the surface density of the Beodeul reference buildings.
